{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_mask = sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
sales_clean = sales[~qa_mask].copy()

# Remove refunded orders (status == 'refunded')
refunded_mask = sales_clean['status'] == 'refunded'
sales_final = sales_clean[~refunded_mask].copy()

# Replace -1 in customer_age with NaN
sales_final['customer_age'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_final['customer_age'], errors='coerce')

# Stratified conversion rates by channel and customer_segment
conversion_by_channel_segment = sales_final.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().reset_index()

# Compute the difference in conversion rate between channels within each segment
# For loyal: email vs paid_search
loyal_diff = conversion_by_channel_segment.loc[conversion_by_channel_segment['customer_segment'] == 'loyal', 'converted'].values[1] - conversion_by_channel_segment.loc[conversion_by_channel_segment['customer_segment'] == 'loyal', 'converted'].values[0]

# For returning: email vs paid_search
returning_diff = conversion_by_channel_segment.loc[conversion_by_channel_segment['customer_segment'] == 'returning', 'converted'].values[1] - conversion_by_channel_segment.loc[conversion_by_channel_segment['customer_segment'] == 'returning', 'converted'].values[0]

# For new: email vs paid_search
new_diff = conversion_by_channel_segment.loc[conversion_by_channel_segment['customer_segment'] == 'new', 'converted'].values[1] - conversion_by_channel_segment.loc[conversion_by_channel_segment['customer_segment'] == 'new', 'converted'].values[0]

# Print the differences
print(f"Difference in conversion rate (paid_search - email) for loyal: {loyal_diff:.4f}")
print(f"Difference in conversion rate (paid_search - email) for returning: {returning_diff:.4f}")
print(f"Difference in conversion rate (paid_search - email) for new: {new_diff:.4f}")"}
